text.zh: 相关管制：(1) 专门为军用用途或目的设计、修改或配备，或主要使用美国国防部资金开发的热端“技术”“受ITAR管辖”（参见22 CFR第120至130部分）。(2) 实际应用于商用“航空器”发动机项目时，“技术”受EAR管辖。出口商可通过以下方式确定其商业应用：就具体出口向商务部申请出口许可证时，提交证明其应用于商业项目的文件，逐案进行认定；或者，在用于广泛类别的“航空器”、发动机、“零件”或“部件”时，向国务院申请商品管辖权裁定。
text.en: Related Controls: (1) Hot section “technology” specifically designed, modified, or equipped for military uses or purposes, or developed principally with U.S. Department of Defense funding, is “subject to the ITAR” (see 22 CFR parts 120 through 130). (2) “Technology” is subject to the EAR when actually applied to a commercial “aircraft” engine program. Exporters may seek to establish commercial application either on a case-by-case basis through submission of documentation demonstrating application to a commercial program in requesting an export license from the Department of Commerce in respect to a specific export, or in the case of use for broad categories of “aircraft,” engines, “parts” or “components,” a commodity jurisdiction determination from the Department of State.

text.zh: 相关定义：不适用
text.en: Related Definitions: N/A

text.zh: 物项：
text.en: Items:

text.zh: a. “开发”或“生产”以下任何燃气涡轮发动机“零件”、“部件”或系统“所必需”的“技术”：
text.en: a. “Technology” “required” for the “development” or “production” of any of the following gas turbine engine “parts,” “components” or systems:

text.zh: a.1. 由定向凝固（DS）或单晶（SC）合金制成的燃气涡轮叶片、导向叶片或“叶尖围带”，根据平均性能值，其（在001米勒指数方向上）在1,273 K（1,000 °C）和200 MPa应力下的持久断裂寿命超过400小时；
text.en: a.1. Gas turbine blades, vanes or “tip shrouds”, made from Directionally Solidified (DS) or Single Crystal (SC) alloys and having (in the 001 Miller Index Direction) a stress-rupture life exceeding 400 hours at 1,273 K (1,000 °C) at a stress of 200 MPa, based on the average property values;

text.zh: 技术注：
text.en: Technical Note:

text.zh: 就9E003.a.1而言，持久断裂寿命试验通常在试样上进行。
text.en: For the purposes of 9E003.a.1, stress-rupture life testing is typically conducted on a test specimen.

text.zh: a.2. 具有以下任何特性的燃烧室：
text.en: a.2. Combustors having any of the following:

text.zh: a.2.a. 设计为在“燃烧室出口温度”超过1,883 K（1,610 °C）时运行的“热解耦衬套”；
text.en: a.2.a. 'Thermally decoupled liners' designed to operate at 'combustor exit temperature' exceeding 1,883 K (1,610 °C);

text.zh: a.2.b. 非金属衬套；
text.en: a.2.b. Non-metallic liners;

text.zh: a.2.c. 非金属壳体；或
text.en: a.2.c. Non-metallic shells; or

text.zh: a.2.d. 设计为在“燃烧室出口温度”超过1,883 K（1,610 °C）时运行，且其孔满足9E003.c所列参数的衬套；
text.en: a.2.d. Liners designed to operate at 'combustor exit temperature' exceeding 1,883 K (1,610 °C) and having holes that meet the parameters specified by 9E003.c;

text.zh: a.2.e. 采用“增压燃烧”；
text.en: a.2.e. Utilizing 'pressure gain combustion';

text.zh: 技术注：
text.en: Technical Note:

text.zh: 就9E003.a.2.e而言，在“增压燃烧”中，当发动机以“稳态模式”运行时，主要由于燃烧过程，燃烧室出口的总体平均滞止压力大于燃烧室进口的总体平均滞止压力。
text.en: For the purposes of 9E003.a.2.e, in 'pressure gain combustion' the bulk average stagnation pressure at the combustor outlet is greater than the bulk average stagnation pressure at the combustor inlet due primarily to the combustion process, when the engine is running in a “steady state mode” of operation.

text.zh: 注：
text.en: Note:

text.zh: 9E003.a.2中孔“所必需”的“技术”仅限于推导孔的几何形状和位置。
text.en: The “required” “technology” for holes in 9E003.a.2 is limited to the derivation of the geometry and location of the holes.

text.zh: 技术注：
text.en: Technical Notes:

text.zh: 1. 就9E003.a.2.a而言，“热解耦衬套”是至少具有设计用于承受机械载荷的支承结构，以及设计用于保护支承结构免受燃烧热影响的迎火结构的衬套。迎火结构和支承结构相对于彼此具有独立的热位移（热载荷引起的机械位移），即两者热解耦。
text.en: 1. For the purposes of 9E003.a.2.a, 'thermally decoupled liners' are liners that feature at least a support structure designed to carry mechanical loads and a combustion facing structure designed to protect the support structure from the heat of combustion. The combustion facing structure and support structure have independent thermal displacement (mechanical displacement due to thermal load) with respect to one another, i.e., they are thermally decoupled.

text.zh: 2. 就9E003.a.2.d而言，“燃烧室出口温度”是当发动机在经认证的最大连续工作温度下以“稳态模式”运行时，燃烧室出口平面与涡轮进口导向叶片前缘之间的总体平均燃气通道总温（滞止温度）（即在SAE ARP 755A定义的发动机T40站位测量）。
text.en: 2. For the purposes of 9E003.a.2.d, 'combustor exit temperature' is the bulk average gas path total (stagnation) temperature between the combustor exit plane and the leading edge of the turbine inlet guide vane (i.e., measured at engine station T40 as defined in SAE ARP 755A) when the engine is running in a “steady state mode” of operation at the certificated maximum continuous operating temperature.

text.zh: 注意：
text.en: N.B.:

text.zh: 关于制造冷却孔“所必需”的“技术”，参见9E003.c。
text.en: See 9E003.c for “technology” “required” for manufacturing cooling holes.

text.zh: a.3. 属于以下任何一种的“零件”或“部件”：
text.en: a.3. “Parts” or “components,” that are any of the following:

text.zh: a.3.a. 由设计为在588 K（315 °C）以上运行的有机“复合”材料制造；
text.en: a.3.a. Manufactured from organic “composite” materials designed to operate above 588 K (315 °C);

text.zh: a.3.b. 由以下任何材料制造：
text.en: a.3.b. Manufactured from any of the following:

text.zh: a.3.b.1. 由以下任何材料增强的金属“基体”“复合材料”：
text.en: a.3.b.1. Metal “matrix” “composites” reinforced by any of the following:

text.zh: a.3.b.1.a. 1C007所管制材料；
text.en: a.3.b.1.a. Materials controlled by 1C007;

text.zh: a.3.b.1.b. 1C010所列“纤维或丝状材料”；或
text.en: a.3.b.1.b. “Fibrous or filamentary materials” specified by 1C010; or

text.zh: a.3.b.1.c. 1C002.a所列铝化物；或
text.en: a.3.b.1.c. Aluminides specified by 1C002.a; or

text.zh: a.3.b.2. 1C007所列陶瓷“基体”“复合材料”；或
text.en: a.3.b.2. Ceramic “matrix” “composites” specified by 1C007; or

text.zh: a.3.c. 满足以下全部条件的定子、导向叶片、叶片、叶尖密封件（围带）、旋转整体叶环、旋转整体叶盘或“分流管道”：
text.en: a.3.c. Stators, vanes, blades, tip seals (shrouds), rotating blings, rotating blisks or 'splitter ducts', that are all of the following:

text.zh: a.3.c.1. 不属于9E003.a.3.a所列物项；
text.en: a.3.c.1. Not specified in 9E003.a.3.a;

text.zh: a.3.c.2. 为压气机或风扇设计；以及
text.en: a.3.c.2. Designed for compressors or fans; and

text.zh: a.3.c.3. 由1C010.e所管制材料与1C008所管制树脂制造；
text.en: a.3.c.3. Manufactured from material controlled by 1C010.e with resins controlled by 1C008;

text.zh: 技术注：
text.en: Technical Note:

text.zh: 就9E003.a.3.c而言，“分流管道”对发动机旁路部分与核心部分之间的空气质量流进行初始分离。
text.en: For the purposes of 9E003.a.3.c, a 'splitter duct' performs the initial separation of the air-mass flow between the bypass and core sections of the engine.

text.zh: a.4. 设计为在1,373 K（1,100 °C）或更高“燃气通道温度”下运行的非冷却涡轮叶片、导向叶片或“叶尖围带”；
text.en: a.4. Uncooled turbine blades, vanes or “tip shrouds” designed to operate at a 'gas path temperature' of 1,373 K (1,100 °C) or more;

text.zh: a.5. 9E003.a.1所述物项以外、设计为在1,693 K（1,420 °C）或更高“燃气通道温度”下运行的冷却涡轮叶片、导向叶片或“叶尖围带”；
text.en: a.5. Cooled turbine blades, vanes or “tip shrouds”, other than those described in 9E003.a.1, designed to operate at a 'gas path temperature' of 1,693 K (1,420 °C) or more;

text.zh: 技术注：
text.en: Technical Note:

text.zh: 就9E003.a.5而言，“燃气通道温度”是当发动机在经认证或规定的最大连续工作温度下以“稳态模式”运行时，涡轮部件前缘平面处的总体平均燃气通道总温（滞止温度）。
text.en: For the purposes of 9E003.a.5, 'gas path temperature' is the bulk average gas path total (stagnation) temperature at the leading-edge plane of the turbine component when the engine is running in a “steady state mode” of operation at the certificated or specified maximum continuous operating temperature.

text.zh: a.6. 采用固态连接的叶身与盘的叶片组合体；
text.en: a.6. Airfoil-to-disk blade combinations using solid state joining;
a.7. [Reserved]

text.zh: a.8. 使用1C002.b所管制粉末冶金材料的“损伤容限”燃气涡轮发动机转子“零件”或“部件”；或
text.en: a.8. 'Damage tolerant' gas turbine engine rotor “parts” or “components” using powder metallurgy materials controlled by 1C002.b; or

text.zh: 技术注：
text.en: Technical Note:

text.zh: 就9E003.a.8而言，“损伤容限”“零件”和“部件”是使用用于预测和限制裂纹扩展的方法和验证手段设计的零件和部件。
text.en: For the purposes of 9E003.a.8, 'damage tolerant' “parts” and “components” are designed using methodology and substantiation to predict and limit crack growth.
a.9. [Reserved]

text.zh: 注意：
text.en: N.B.:

text.zh: 关于“FADEC系统”，参见9E003.h。
text.en: For “FADEC systems”, see 9E003.h.
a.10. [Reserved]

text.zh: 注意：
text.en: N.B.:

text.zh: 关于可调流道几何形状，参见9E003.i。
text.en: For adjustable flow path geometry, see 9E003.i.

text.zh: a.11. 具有以下全部特性的“风扇叶片”：
text.en: a.11. 'Fan blades' having all of the following:

text.zh: a.11.a. 总体积的20%或以上由仅含真空或气体的1个或多个封闭空腔构成；以及
text.en: a.11.a. 20% or more of the total volume being one or more closed cavities containing vacuum or gas only; and

text.zh: a.11.b. 1个或多个封闭空腔的体积为5 cm^{3}或以上；
text.en: a.11.b. One or more closed cavities having a volume of 5 cm^{3} or larger;

text.zh: 技术注：
text.en: Technical Note:

text.zh: 就9E003.a.11而言，“风扇叶片”是燃气涡轮发动机中为压气机和旁路同时提供气流的1级或多级旋转级的翼型部分。
text.en: For the purposes of 9E003.a.11, a 'fan blade' is the aerofoil portion of the rotating stage or stages, which provide both compressor and bypass flow in a gas turbine engine.

text.zh: b. “开发”或“生产”以下任何物项“所必需”的“技术”：
text.en: b. “Technology” “required” for the “development” or “production” of any of the following:

text.zh: b.1. 装备非侵入式传感器，且能够将传感器数据传输至数据采集系统的风洞航空模型；或
text.en: b.1. Wind tunnel aero-models equipped with non-intrusive sensors capable of transmitting data from the sensors to the data acquisition system; or

text.zh: b.2. 能够在超过0.55马赫的飞行速度下吸收超过2,000 kW功率的“复合材料”螺旋桨叶片或桨扇；
text.en: b.2. “Composite” propeller blades or prop-fans, capable of absorbing more than 2,000 kW at flight speeds exceeding Mach 0.55;

text.zh: c. 在采用9E003.a.1、9E003.a.2或9E003.a.5所列任何“技术”的燃气涡轮发动机“零件”或“部件”上制造冷却孔“所必需”的“技术”，且冷却孔具有以下任何特征：
text.en: c. “Technology” “required” for manufacturing cooling holes in gas turbine engine “parts” or “components” incorporating any of the “technologies” specified by 9E003.a.1, 9E003.a.2, or 9E003.a.5, and having any of the following:

text.zh: c.1. 具有以下全部特性：
text.en: c.1. Having all of the following:

text.zh: c.1.a. 最小“横截面积”小于0.45 mm^{2}；
text.en: c.1.a. Minimum 'cross-sectional area' less than 0.45 mm^{2};

text.zh: c.1.b. “孔形比”大于4.52；以及
text.en: c.1.b. 'Hole shape ratio' greater than 4.52; and

text.zh: c.1.c. “入射角”等于或小于25°；或
text.en: c.1.c. 'Incidence angle' equal to or less than 25°; or

text.zh: c.2. 具有以下全部特性：
text.en: c.2. Having all of the following:

text.zh: c.2.a. 最小“横截面积”小于0.12 mm^{2}；
text.en: c.2.a. Minimum 'cross-sectional area' less than 0.12 mm^{2};

text.zh: c.2.b. “孔形比”大于5.65；以及
text.en: c.2.b. 'Hole shape ratio' greater than 5.65; and

text.zh: c.2.c. “入射角”大于25°；
text.en: c.2.c. 'Incidence angle' more than 25°;

text.zh: 注：
text.en: Note:

text.zh: 9E003.c不适用于制造等半径圆柱形直通孔的“技术”，该孔的进口和出口均位于部件外表面。
text.en: 9E003.c does not apply to “technology” for manufacturing constant radius cylindrical holes that are straight through and enter and exit on the external surfaces of the component.

text.zh: 技术注：
text.en: Technical Notes:

text.zh: 1. 就9E003.c而言，“横截面积”是垂直于孔轴线的平面内孔的面积。
text.en: 1. For the purposes of 9E003.c, the 'cross-sectional area' is the area of the hole in the plane perpendicular to the hole axis.

text.zh: 2. 就9E003.c而言，“孔形比”是孔轴线的标称长度除以其最小“横截面积”的平方根。
text.en: 2. For the purposes of 9E003.c, 'hole shape ratio' is the nominal length of the axis of the hole divided by the square root of its minimum 'cross-sectional area'.

text.zh: 3. 就9E003.c而言，“入射角”是在孔轴线进入翼型表面处，翼型表面切平面与孔轴线之间测得的锐角。
text.en: 3. For the purposes of 9E003.c, 'incidence angle' is the acute angle measured between the plane tangential to the airfoil surface and the hole axis at the point where the hole axis enters the airfoil surface.

text.zh: 4. 就9E003.c而言，孔的制造方法包括“激光”束加工、水射流加工、电化学加工（ECM）或电火花加工（EDM）。
text.en: 4. For the purposes of 9E003.c, methods for manufacturing holes include “laser” beam machining, water jet machining, Electro-Chemical Machining (ECM) or Electrical Discharge Machining (EDM).

text.zh: d. “开发”或“生产”直升机动力传输系统，或倾转旋翼或倾转机翼“航空器”动力传输系统“所必需”的“技术”；
text.en: d. “Technology” “required” for the “development” or “production” of helicopter power transfer systems or tilt rotor or tilt wing “aircraft” power transfer systems;

text.zh: e. 用于“开发”或“生产”具有以下全部特性的往复式柴油发动机地面车辆推进系统的“技术”：
text.en: e. “Technology” for the “development” or “production” of reciprocating diesel engine ground vehicle propulsion systems having all of the following:

text.zh: e.1. “包络体积”为1.2 m^{3}或以下；
text.en: e.1. 'Box volume' of 1.2 m^{3} or less;

text.zh: e.2. 根据80/1269/EEC、ISO 2534或等效国家标准，总输出功率超过750 kW；以及
text.en: e.2. An overall power output of more than 750 kW based on 80/1269/EEC, ISO 2534 or national equivalents; and

text.zh: e.3. 按“包络体积”计算的功率密度超过700 kW/m^{3}；
text.en: e.3. Power density of more than 700 kW/m^{3} of 'box volume';

text.zh: 技术注：
text.en: Technical Note:

text.zh: 就9E003.e.1.而言，“包络体积”是按以下方式测量的3个相互垂直尺寸的乘积：
text.en: For the purposes of 9E003.e.1., 'box volume' is the product of three perpendicular dimensions measured in the following way:

text.zh: 长度：曲轴从前法兰到飞轮端面的长度；
text.en: Length: The length of the crankshaft from front flange to flywheel face;

text.zh: 宽度：以下任一尺寸中的最大值：
text.en: Width: The widest of any of the following:

text.zh: a. 从气门室盖到气门室盖的外部尺寸；
text.en: a. The outside dimension from valve cover to valve cover;

text.zh: b. 气缸盖外缘尺寸；或
text.en: b. The dimensions of the outside edges of the cylinder heads; or

text.zh: c. 飞轮壳直径；
text.en: c. The diameter of the flywheel housing;

text.zh: 高度：以下任一尺寸中的最大值：
text.en: Height: The largest of any of the following:

text.zh: a. 曲轴中心线至气门室盖（或气缸盖）顶面的尺寸，加上2倍行程；或
text.en: a. The dimension of the crankshaft center-line to the top plane of the valve cover (or cylinder head) plus twice the stroke; or

text.zh: b. 飞轮壳直径。
text.en: b. The diameter of the flywheel housing.

text.zh: f. “生产”以下为高功率柴油发动机“专门设计”的“零件”或“部件”“所必需”的“技术”：
text.en: f. “Technology” “required” for the “production” of “specially designed” “parts” or “components” for high output diesel engines, as follows:

text.zh: f.1. “生产”具有以下全部采用1C007所管制陶瓷材料的“零件”和“部件”的发动机系统“所必需”的“技术”：
text.en: f.1. “Technology” “required” for the “production” of engine systems having all of the following “parts” and “components” employing ceramics materials controlled by 1C007:

text.zh: f.1.a 气缸套；
text.en: f.1.a Cylinder liners;

text.zh: f.1.b. 活塞；
text.en: f.1.b. Pistons;

text.zh: f.1.c. 气缸盖；以及
text.en: f.1.c. Cylinder heads; and

text.zh: f.1.d. 1种或多种其他“零件”或“部件”（包括排气口、涡轮增压器、气门导管、气门组件或隔热喷油器）；
text.en: f.1.d. One or more other “part” or “component” (including exhaust ports, turbochargers, valve guides, valve assemblies or insulated fuel injectors);

text.zh: f.2. “生产”具有单级压气机且满足以下全部条件的涡轮增压系统“所必需”的“技术”：
text.en: f.2. “Technology” “required” for the “production” of turbocharger systems with single-stage compressors and having all of the following:

text.zh: f.2.a. 工作压比为4:1或以上；
text.en: f.2.a. Operating at pressure ratios of 4:1 or higher;

text.zh: f.2.b. 质量流量范围为每分钟30至130 kg；以及
text.en: f.2.b. Mass flow in the range from 30 to 130 kg per minute; and

text.zh: f.2.c. 在压气机或涡轮部分内具有可变流通面积能力；
text.en: f.2.c. Variable flow area capability within the compressor or turbine sections;

text.zh: f.3. “生产”具有“专门设计”的多燃料（例如柴油或喷气燃料）适用能力，覆盖从柴油（在310.8 K（37.8 °C）时为2.5 cSt）至汽油（在310.8 K（37.8 °C）时为0.5 cSt）的黏度范围，且具有以下全部特性的燃油喷射系统“所必需”的“技术”：
text.en: f.3. “Technology” “required” for the “production” of fuel injection systems with a “specially designed” multifuel (e.g., diesel or jet fuel) capability covering a viscosity range from diesel fuel (2.5 cSt at 310.8 K (37.8 °C)) down to gasoline fuel (0.5 cSt at 310.8 K (37.8 °C)) and having all of the following:

text.zh: f.3.a. 每缸每次喷射量超过230 mm^{3}；以及
text.en: f.3.a. Injection amount in excess of 230 mm^{3} per injection per cylinder; and

text.zh: f.3.b. 具有“专门设计”的电子控制功能，能够根据燃料特性自动切换调速器特性，并通过使用适当的传感器提供相同的扭矩特性；
text.en: f.3.b. Electronic control features “specially designed” for switching governor characteristics automatically depending on fuel property to provide the same torque characteristics by using the appropriate sensors;

text.zh: g. “开发”或“生产”采用固体、气相或液膜（或其组合）气缸壁润滑，并允许在超过723 K（450 °C）的温度下运行的“高功率柴油发动机”“所必需”的“技术”，该温度在活塞顶环行程上限处的气缸壁上测量；
text.en: g. “Technology” “required” for the “development” or “production” of 'high output diesel engines' for solid, gas phase or liquid film (or combinations thereof) cylinder wall lubrication and permitting operation to temperatures exceeding 723 K (450 °C), measured on the cylinder wall at the top limit of travel of the top ring of the piston;

text.zh: 技术注：
text.en: Technical Note:

text.zh: 就9E003.g而言，“高功率柴油发动机”是指在2,300 r.p.m.转速下规定的制动平均有效压力为1.8 MPa或以上的柴油发动机，且其额定转速为2,300 r.p.m.或以上。
text.en: For the purposes of 9E003.g, 'high output diesel engines' are diesel engines with a specified brake mean effective pressure of 1.8 MPa or more at a speed of 2,300 r.p.m., provided the rated speed is 2,300 r.p.m. or more.

text.zh: h. 以下燃气涡轮发动机“FADEC系统”的“技术”：
text.en: h. “Technology” for gas turbine engine “FADEC systems” as follows:

text.zh: h.1. 用于推导“FADEC系统”调节发动机推力或轴功率所需“零件”或“部件”的功能要求（例如反馈传感器的时间常数和精度、燃油阀转换速率）的“开发”“技术”；
text.en: h.1. “Development” “technology” for deriving the functional requirements for the “parts” or “components” necessary for the “FADEC system” to regulate engine thrust or shaft power (e.g., feedback sensor time constants and accuracies, fuel valve slew rate);

text.zh: h.2. 用于“FADEC系统”特有且用于调节发动机推力或轴功率的控制与诊断“零件”或“部件”的“开发”或“生产”“技术”；
text.en: h.2. “Development” or “production” “technology” for control and diagnostic “parts” or “components” unique to the “FADEC system” and used to regulate engine thrust or shaft power;

text.zh: h.3. 用于“FADEC系统”特有且用于调节发动机推力或轴功率的控制律算法（包括“源代码”）的“开发”“技术”；
text.en: h.3. “Development” “technology” for the control law algorithms, including “source code”, unique to the “FADEC system” and used to regulate engine thrust or shaft power;

text.zh: 注：
text.en: Note:

text.zh: 9E003.h不适用于与发动机和“航空器”集成有关、且1个或多个瓦森纳安排参与国（参见EAR第743部分补编第1号）的民航主管机关要求公开以供航空公司普遍使用的技术（例如安装手册、操作说明、持续适航说明），也不适用于接口功能（例如输入/输出处理、机体推力或轴功率需求）有关的技术。
text.en: 9E003.h does not apply to technology related to engine-“aircraft” integration required by civil aviation authorities of one or more Wassenaar Arrangement Participating States (See Supplement No. 1 to part 743 of the EAR) to be published for general airline use (e.g., installation manuals, operating instructions, instructions for continued airworthiness) or interface functions (e.g., input/output processing, airframe thrust or shaft power demand).

text.zh: i. 以下为燃气发生器涡轮、风扇或动力涡轮或推进喷嘴设计、用于保持发动机稳定性的可调流道系统“技术”：
text.en: i. “Technology” for adjustable flow path systems designed to maintain engine stability for gas generator turbines, fan or power turbines, or propelling nozzles, as follows:

text.zh: i.1. 用于推导保持发动机稳定性的“零件”或“部件”功能要求的“开发”“技术”；
text.en: i.1. “Development” “technology” for deriving the functional requirements for the “parts” or “components” that maintain engine stability;

text.zh: i.2. 用于可调流道系统特有且保持发动机稳定性的“零件”或“部件”的“开发”或“生产”“技术”；
text.en: i.2. “Development” or “production” “technology” for “parts” or “components” unique to the adjustable flow path system and that maintain engine stability;

text.zh: i.3. 用于可调流道系统特有且保持发动机稳定性的控制律算法（包括“源代码”）的“开发”“技术”；
text.en: i.3. “Development” “technology” for the control law algorithms, including “source code”, unique to the adjustable flow path system and that maintain engine stability;

text.zh: 注：
text.en: Note:

text.zh: 9E003.i不适用于以下任何物项的“技术”：
text.en: 9E003.i does not apply to “technology” for any of the following:

text.zh: a. 进口导向叶片；
text.en: a. Inlet guide vanes;

text.zh: b. 可变桨距风扇或桨扇；
text.en: b. Variable pitch fans or prop-fans;

text.zh: c. 可变压气机导向叶片；
text.en: c. Variable compressor vanes;

text.zh: d. 压气机放气阀；或
text.en: d. Compressor bleed valves; or

text.zh: e. 用于反推力的可调流道几何形状。
text.en: e. Adjustable flow path geometry for reverse thrust.

text.zh: j. “开发”为燃气涡轮发动机驱动的固定翼“航空器”设计的机翼折叠系统“所必需”的“技术”。
text.en: j. “Technology” “required” for the “development” of wing-folding systems designed for fixed-wing “aircraft” powered by gas turbine engines.

text.zh: 注意：
text.en: N.B.:

text.zh: 关于“开发”为USML第VIII(a)类所列固定翼“航空器”设计的机翼折叠系统“所必需”的“技术”，参见USML第VIII(i)类。
text.en: For “technology” “required” for the “development” of wing-folding systems designed for fixed-wing “aircraft” specified in USML Category VIII (a), see USML Category VIII (i).

text.zh: k. 9E003.a、9E003.h或9E003.i未列明的、为使“航空器”能够以1马赫或更高速度巡航超过30分钟而为航空燃气涡轮发动机“专门设计”的以下任何部件或系统的“开发”“所必需”的“技术”：
text.en: k. “Technology”, not specified in 9E003.a, 9E003.h, or 9E003.i, “required” for the “development” of any of the following components or systems, “specially designed” for aero gas turbine engines to enable “aircraft” to cruise at Mach 1 or greater for more than 30 minutes:

text.zh: k.1. 推进进气系统；
text.en: k.1. Propulsion inlet systems;

text.zh: k.2. 推进排气系统；
text.en: k.2. Propulsion exhaust systems;

text.zh: k.3. “加力系统”；
text.en: k.3. 'Reheat systems';

text.zh: k.4. 用于调节润滑或冷却“发动机转子支承”所用流体的“主动热管理系统”；
text.en: k.4. 'Active thermal management systems' to condition fluids used to lubricate or cool 'engine rotor supports';

text.zh: k.5. 无油“发动机转子支承”；或
text.en: k.5. Oil-free 'engine rotor supports'; or

text.zh: k.6. 从“压缩系统”核心燃气通道气流中移除热量的系统。
text.en: k.6. Systems to remove heat from 'compression system' core gas path flow.

text.zh: 技术注：
text.en: Technical Notes:

text.zh: 就9E003.k而言：
text.en: For the purposes of 9E003.k:

text.zh: 1. 推进进气系统包括核心气流预冷器。
text.en: 1. Propulsion inlet systems include core flow pre-coolers.

text.zh: 2. “加力系统”通过在最后一级涡轮机械下游的排气和/或旁路气流中燃烧燃料来提供额外推力。“加力系统”也称为加力燃烧室。
text.en: 2. 'Reheat systems' provide additional thrust by combusting fuel in exhaust and/or bypass flow downstream of the last turbomachinery stage. 'Reheat systems' are also referred to as afterburners.

text.zh: 3. “主动热管理系统”采用被动式油—空气冷却或油—燃料冷却以外的方法，例如蒸气循环系统。
text.en: 3. 'Active thermal management systems' employ methods other than passive oil-to-air cooling or oil-to-fuel cooling, such as vapor cycle systems.

text.zh: 4. “压缩系统”是发动机进气面与燃烧室之间，通过机械功提高气流通道压力的任何一级或多级组合。
text.en: 4. 'Compression system' is any stage or combination of stages between the engine inlet face and the combustor that increases gas path pressure through mechanical work.

text.zh: 5. “发动机转子支承”是支承发动机主轴的轴承，该主轴驱动压缩系统或涡轮转子。
text.en: 5. An 'engine rotor support' is the bearing supporting the main engine shaft that drives the compression system or turbine rotors.

text.zh: 注意1
text.en: N.B. 1

text.zh: 发动机控制技术见9E003.h。
text.en: See 9E003.h, for engine control technology.

text.zh: 注意2
text.en: N.B. 2

text.zh: 可调流道系统技术见9E003.i。
text.en: See 9E003.i, for adjustable flow path systems technology.

text.zh: l. 未由9E003.a.1至a.8、a.10及.h另行管制，用于美国军品清单所管制军用发动机的民用衍生型热端“零件”或“部件”的“开发”“生产”或大修的“技术”。
text.en: l. “Technology” not otherwise controlled in 9E003.a.1 through a.8, a.10, and .h and used in the “development”, “production”, or overhaul of hot section “parts” or “components” of civil derivatives of military engines controlled on the U.S. Munitions List.

text.zh: 9E018 用于9A018所管制设备的“开发”“生产”或“使用”的“技术”。
text.en: 9E018 “Technology” for the “development,” “production,” or “use” of equipment controlled by 9A018.

text.zh: (a) 对于在2013年10月15日之前紧接该日的时点归入9A018.a.1、.a.3、.c、.d、.e或.f的航空器、加油设备、地面设备、降落伞、背带、仪表飞行训练器，以及上述物项的“零件”“附件”和“附属装置”的相关“技术”，见ECCN 9E610。
text.en: (a) See ECCN 9E610 for “technology” related to aircraft, refuelers, ground equipment, parachutes, harnesses, instrument flight trainers and “parts”, “accessories” and “attachments” for the forgoing that, immediately prior to October 15, 2013, were classified under 9A018.a.1, .a.3, .c, .d, .e, or .f.

text.zh: (b) 对于在2013年10月15日之前紧接该日的时点归入ECCN 9A018.a.2或.a.3的军用教练机涡轮螺旋桨发动机及其“零件”和“部件”的相关“技术”，见ECCN 9E619。
text.en: (b) See ECCN 9E619 for “technology” related to military trainer aircraft turbo prop engines and “parts” and “components” therefor that, immediately prior to October 15, 2013, were classified under ECCN 9A018.a.2 or .a.3.

text.zh: (c) 在2014年1月6日之前归入ECCN 9A018.b的某些装甲陆地运输车辆的相关技术属于EAR99（见0E606）。
text.en: (c) Technology related to certain armored ground transport vehicles that prior to January 6, 2014 were classified under ECCN 9A018.b is EAR99 (See 0E606).

text.zh: 相关管制：(1) 就本条目而言，“使用”“技术”仅限于因MT原因管制的物项及其分系统。(2) ECCN 9A004（受EAR管辖的物项除外）、9A005至9A011、9A101.b（受EAR管辖的物项除外）、9A104、9A105、9A106.a、.b和.c、9A107至9A109、9A110（适用于为导弹系统和分系统“专门设计”的物项）、9A111、9A115至9A119、9D103及9D105所列物项的“技术”“受ITAR管辖”（见22 CFR第121部分）。
text.en: Related Controls: (1) For the purpose of this entry, “use” “technology” is limited to items controlled for MT and their subsystems. (2) “Technology” for items specified in ECCNs 9A004 (except for items that are subject to the EAR), 9A005 to 9A011, 9A101.b (except for items that are subject to the EAR), 9A104, 9A105, 9A106.a, .b and .c, 9A107 to 9A109, 9A110 (for items that are “specially designed” for use in missile systems and subsystems), 9A111, 9A115 to 9A119, 9D103, and 9D105 is “subject to the ITAR” (see 22 CFR part 121).

text.zh: 相关定义：不适用
text.en: Related Definitions: N/A

text.zh: 物项：受管制物项清单载于ECCN标题中。
text.en: Items: The list of items controlled is contained in the ECCN heading.
